data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced mixed prior year development in 2017, with a gross strengthening of GBP 0.441m. This was primarily driven by a strengthening on the 2015 underwriting year, partially offset by a release on the 2014 underwriting year. The report also noted the commutation of a material US Casualty contract at a profit for both the 2015 and 2016 years of account, which would typically indicate a release, but this is not fully reflected in the aggregate gross claims development.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development of +GBP 0.441m calculated from the claims development table. This contrasts with a narrative statement on page 40 of an 'overall deficit of GBP 1.8m on prior year reserves', which is explicitly stated as a net figure. The claims development table shows a strengthening for the 2015 YOA, which appears to contradict the narrative of a 'material US Casualty contract' being commuted at a profit for the 2015 YOA. LOB breakdown for prior year development not available.
